title: Pairs of differential forms: a framework for precontact geometry
summary: Precontact manifolds extend contact geometry by weakening the maximal non-integrability condition of the defining $1$-form. We clarify the geometric foundations of this structure by studying general pairs of a $1$-form and a $2$-form under mild regularity conditions. We characterize them through their class, analyse the role of distinguished vector fields, such as Reeb or Liouville fields, and study other associated geometrical objects.
